name: Lisa
description: Approved red-haired anime character; portable painted-pose animation library

appearance.hair: deep burgundy, long; original wavy and approved straight variants
appearance.face: warm red-brown almond eyes, tapered oval face, peach skin
appearance.base_outfit: black ribbed sleeveless crop top, black short pleated skirt, normal belt, black strappy block-heel sandals
variants: sleeve outer layer over sleeveless base
opaque black briefs with lowercase virat front waistband

sequences.title: Whip motion toward an empty floor

state_machine.note: Suggested application mapping, not an autonomous AI agent.

notes: Original images remain available at their native resolution.
Pose-loop deformation is restrained; large limb actions use held key poses and short cross-dissolves.
Reference studies use gentle zoom loops, not invented body movement.
Retain independent clothing and hair variants; reference artwork can contain small proportions or costume differences.
A production Live2D/Spine/3D rig requires separated artwork or a mesh and is not included.
